approval_required_for: Any architecture, pipeline, memory-layout, numeric-policy, tolerance, or major-template change
Any lower-layer reopen or backtrack without a current accepted trace explicitly contradicting a named invariant
Promotion to backend synthesis, implementation, bitstream, runtime ABI, or board runtime before a fresh complete Stage7 certificate

consumes: immutable checkpoint, stimulus, target-model expected output, and numeric policy
executable_actions.on_failure: Remain needs_repair. Do not reuse the old unattributed termination, repeat the rejected unchanged-source observation transaction, edit RTL or the certified kernel, alter the loader/manifest/testbench, reopen lower layers, or promote. Escalate the missing capability implementation rather than weakening the analyzer.
produces: planned capability implementation task for distinct board VCS termination provenance
current hash-bound core-boundary observations if valid
executable_actions.rationale: The prior VCS evidence is external_or_unattributed and does not distinguish runner termination from adapter, wrapper, AXI/DDR, or certified-kernel progress. A grounded capture capability is missing; implement and execute it before any source, loader, monitor, manifest, testbench, or RTL repair. The capture must use the exact current sample-project source closure and preserve all immutable functional inputs.

consumes: exact Vivado export facts and contexts
executable_actions.on_failure: Keep case_axi_ddr_interface blocked and return to this contract repair. Do not run dependency-skipped VCS as acceptance, do not infer a DUT failure, and do not modify checkpoint, stimulus, target reference, tolerance, testbench contract, or exact wrapper sources.
produces: planned capability implementation task for exact board identity and compile-authority rebinding
current board identity document bound to the exact source closure
current VCS compile plan with exact Vivado authority references
rebound board simulation and semantic-loader contract
executable_actions.rationale: The direct current checker failure is an unbound exact board contract. Rebind the source identity, exact Vivado export facts, compile authority, ordered command authority references, and executable authorization to the user-supplied sample project. Bind the board loader/harness to the immutable semantic package and Transformer-block weight subset without adding model-tail work. This is a planned capability because the grounded registry has no existing exact-contract rebinder; implementation must not guess target names or substitute a wrapper.

executable_actions.on_failure: Stop the current-layer DAG and return to repair_step.02. Treat all dependent gates as not_run evidence gaps; do not invoke VCS acceptance, patch RTL, reopen lower layers, or proceed to backend.
executable_actions.rationale: After the exact identity and authority contract is rebound, rerun the direct failed current-layer gate using fresh evidence. This gate is the prerequisite for VCS functional simulation and all downstream board checks.

consumes: current exact source and authority hashes
immutable numeric comparison policy and tolerance
executable_actions.on_failure: Keep the board layer at needs_repair. If the failure is a contract or termination-provenance failure, return to repair_step.01 or repair_step.02. If a deterministic simulator failure or stall is proven, execute repair_step.05 before any code repair. Do not promote or rerun certified lower-layer tools merely because a board output frontier is stalled.
produces: fresh current-layer real-tool evidence and weight-consumption evidence
executable_actions.rationale: Only after case_axi_ddr_interface passes, execute the exact board-layer DAG in dependency order: VCS functional simulation, diagnostic analysis, deadlock/AXI checks, multilayer functional comparison, pipeline deadlock check, AXI protocol check, DDR image round-trip, and board semantic evidence. Use independent target-model outputs for the same immutable checkpoint and stimulus and verify complete required Transformer-block weight consumption. Do not treat the old ready trace or random data as evidence.

consumes: current VCS log and simulator termination provenance
current exact identity and board source hashes
current checkpoint, stimulus, target-model reference, and immutable numeric policy
executable_actions.on_failure: Do not apply a code patch or infer a root cause. If termination remains unattributed, request repair_step.01 again with a diagnostically distinct capture. If and only if the accepted trace directly contradicts a named lower-layer invariant with current core start, ingress, egress, causal-boundary, and certificate evidence, create a targeted SACG backtrack for only that challenged lower scope; otherwise preserve lower-layer certificates and repair only the board integration slice.
produces: targeted replay report using the same checkpoint and stimulus
failure-localization report naming the earliest violated board boundary
causal repair context with CCTG slice and any root candidate
explicit lower-layer contradiction record only if direct core evidence disproves a named invariant
executable_actions.rationale: A deterministic current-layer VCS failure requires current hash-bound trace evidence before selecting a repair owner. Capture accepted-token order, direct core start, ingress and egress handshakes, output/lifecycle frontier, AXI/DDR progress, named causal boundary, and termination provenance, then construct the CCTG causal slice. A frontier stall alone is insufficient to reopen the connected kernel.

consumes: fresh VCS functional and diagnostic reports
fresh multilayer, deadlock, AXI, DDR, and board semantic reports
sacg_memory_truth open retry requests and active contamination barriers
current source, checkpoint, stimulus, target-reference, numeric-policy, testbench, and wrapper hashes
executable_actions.on_failure: Remain needs_repair, retain the active contamination barriers, and route the failed current-layer checker back through the same-layer repair loop. Do not promote to Vivado, bitstream, runtime ABI, or board runtime, and do not claim functional or hardware pass.
produces: promotion decision for board_axi_ddr_closure only if all required gates pass
executable_actions.rationale: After all current board gates pass with fresh hash-bound evidence, reconcile the open same-stage retries and issue a new authoritative Stage7 result. The refined current-stage contract may supersede prior failed artifacts only after every current-stage checker passes; no rejected artifact may be silently promoted.

observations: The executed real_tool.case_axi_ddr_interface failure is specifically that the current source identity hash, Vivado-export compile authority, ordered command authority references, and simulator executable authorization are not bound to the current exact sample-project identity. This is a current board verification/harness contract failure.

functional_sim is not valid board evidence: VCS functional simulation was dependency-skipped behind case_axi_ddr_interface, and the downstream multilayer, deadlock, AXI protocol, DDR round-trip, and board semantic gates are not_run. Their absence is an evidence gap, not proof of a hardware value or liveness failure.

The prior VCS feedback reports an ingress-complete/output-frontier stall and external_or_unattributed termination, but it does not identify a deterministic HDL, adapter, kernel, AXI/DDR, loader, or testbench owner. The historical diagnosis is non-executable because its source hash and gate/layer binding are stale.

The first current-layer diagnostic must therefore be a distinct termination-provenance capture, not the rejected unchanged-source observation replay. No adapter, monitor, loader, manifest, testbench, certified-kernel, or lower-layer source repair is authorized before that evidence is captured.

Live operator-leaf and connected single-transformer-layer certificates pass and the hierarchical learning context contains no current hash-bound contradiction. Their elastic variable-latency boundary order and cross-token overlap invariants remain reusable; unequal stage durations do not require same-cycle start or finish.

The current output-frontier symptom is localization evidence only. Independent AXI/DDR or prefetch progress cannot be treated as output or lifecycle progress, and the symptom alone cannot reopen the certified connected kernel.

sacg_memory_truth reports six open retry requests and no open backtrack request for this scope. Active contamination barriers require rejected verification and repair artifacts to remain planning/debug evidence only. Same-stage retries remain downstream-promotion blockers until a refined current contract passes and is promoted; they do not independently block authorizing this bounded refined contract.

Any board functional pass must use a complete checkpoint tensor catalog with an explicit Transformer-block DUT subset, deterministic or real input provenance, target-model inference expected outputs for the same checkpoint and stimulus, the immutable numeric policy, generated semantic-testbench hashes, and executed proof that every required bound Transformer-block weight was consumed. Embedding/tokenization, final norm, LM head/logits, sampling, and other model-tail work remain outside the DUT golden and weight-consumption boundary.
The conditional design-team route returned no_split, so there is no specialist repair decision that can override the deterministic checker and real-tool requirements.
proposed_actions: Request a distinct current-source remote VCS termination-provenance and boundary-observation capture while preserving the immutable checkpoint, stimulus, target reference, numeric policy, weight bindings, and exact sample-project source closure.

After that capture, repair/rebind only the exact board simulation identity, Vivado-authorized compile plan, ordered authority references, executable authorization, and board semantic loader/harness contract; do not substitute a simplified wrapper.
Rerun case_axi_ddr_interface and require a fresh pass before VCS or any dependent board gate.

If the interface gate passes, run the current board-layer DAG with the exact wrapper and immutable semantic artifacts. If a deterministic simulator failure or frontier stall remains, obtain a current hash-bound trace and CCTG causal slice before any code patch.

Only a trace that directly names a lower-layer invariant contradiction may create a targeted lower-layer backtrack; otherwise retain both lower-layer certificates and repair the current board integration slice. Promote only after the complete Stage7 authoritative rerun passes.
risks: Rebinding an identity document or simulator executable without exact current Vivado export evidence could contaminate the verification artifact chain and falsely authorize simulation.
Reusing the prior unattributed VCS run or the historical diagnosis could cause an incorrect RTL or connected-kernel repair and would violate the current SACG repair evidence policy.

A board-level stall can be caused by lifecycle ordering, data order, address mapping, memory/AXI progress, wrapper integration, simulator termination, or kernel progress; no owner is established without a current hash-bound causal boundary trace.

Missing semantic evidence or on-disk weight files do not prove target-model correctness or DUT weight consumption. Randomly generated expected outputs, RTL-derived goldens, identity fallbacks, sampled weights, and tolerance changes are prohibited.

Changing model shape interpretation, data order, memory layout, numeric tolerance, testbench contract, checkpoint, stimulus, or exact wrapper source during this repair would invalidate the current comparison and board evidence.
Running downstream board gates or backend/board-runtime actions before the repaired interface and VCS evidence pass would bypass the hierarchical DAG and active contamination barriers.

checkpoint, stimulus, target reference, numeric policy, testbench contract, and wrapper hashes remain immutable

current tool profile or referenced Vivado export -> ordered command executable authorization
case_vcs_functional_sim -> multilayer functional, deadlock, AXI, DDR, and board semantic gates
independent AXI/DDR or prefetch progress does not establish output-frontier progress
current hash-bound core start/ingress/egress trace -> conditional causal localization
current trace explicitly contradicting a named lower-layer invariant -> only then targeted lower-layer revalidation

output.summary: Fail-closed bounded-repair decision: the current board-layer blocker is an exact board-simulation verification-contract failure, not a proven DUT or lower-layer defect. Capture diagnostically distinct VCS termination provenance, repair and hash-bind the exact sample-project identity/Vivado-authorized compile plan, rerun the board layer in dependency order, and use a current board boundary trace for any later causal repair. Do not reopen certified operator or connected-kernel layers, promote to backend, or claim hardware correctness.
